description: §19.7.1 / §18.6 (S474, PERMANENT — security) — `_`, the alias of `else`, absorbing error variants: once after `.Ok(v)` in a `return match` (it would take `.Denied` and `.Locked`), once after `.Denied` in a statement-position `match` (it would take `.Locked`). Each is E-MATCH-ELSE-ABSORBS-ERROR — two diagnostics.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S474 "⭐ RULED — `else` on a failable match; `scrml fix` S466 readings" item 1 — "on a failable subject, `else` covers success variants only"
rationale: §18.6: `_` is a valid alias for `else`. §19.7.1 (S474): on a failable result either covers `.Ok` only, so each `match` here leaves an error variant to its wildcard: E-MATCH-ELSE-ABSORBS-ERROR, once per `match`, in a `return` position and a statement position alike.
